_comment: A classic escalation setup for `chains`/`stealth`. An attacker service account starts with only iam.serviceAccountKeys.create; the `attack` block wires each technique's gains so the search can climb key -> token -> Owner. Load a candidates file first (examples/candidates_medium.decn or _advanced.decn).
_expect: chains resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy --from iam.serviceAccountKeys.create  ->  finds a STEALTHY multi-hop path (with no rules loaded, nothing catches it).
stealth escalate_owner  ->  EVASIVE as the human; load the GCP corpus and a SetIamPolicy owner-grant rule flips it to always_detected.
blindspots iam.serviceAccountKeys.create  ->  reachable + logged; a gap unless a key-creation rule is loaded.
name: escalation-path
